operation: Bound a local actor's information after a public update.
boundary: Synthetic local actor B and a published rule; the task concerns knowledge only, not legal validity or enforcement.
input: A rule has been published and is in legal effect. B has not received it and has no established unofficial information path. BASE: the simulation knows the publication occurred. VARIANT: an official notice reaches a local office but has not reached B. State what knowledge can be assigned to B in each case. Preserve missing knowledge as UNKNOWN; do not invent delivery, awareness, agreement, or action.
protected_distinction: WORLD UPDATED != ACTOR UPDATED; PUBLICATION != RECEIPT; LEGAL_EFFECT != KNOWLEDGE
forbidden_conversion: Grant B the new rule's contents from publication, legal effect, simulation knowledge, or receipt by a different local actor.
